note: Curated anime indexer catalogue for Settings → Indexers → + Add. Each entry was checked live on the date in `checked`. Update this file to change the catalogue; no code change needed.

entries.name: AnimeTosho (Usenet)
entries.language: English subs (mirrors fansub and simulcast releases)
entries.goodFor: Free anime NZBs: Usenet mirrors of nearly every Nyaa release, no account needed.

checked.note: Newznab API answers at animetosho.org/feed/api (caps + search OK). The old feed.animetosho.org host no longer resolves. Anonymous NZB downloads are rate-limited (apilimits apimax=1), and AnimeArr saw NZB fetch failures from storage.animetosho.org; keep a second Usenet indexer.

entries.name: AnimeTosho (torrents)
entries.goodFor: One search over Nyaa, TokyoTosho and AniDex torrents, with file lists and sizes.

checked.note: Torznab-style search answers (torrent and magnet links to the source trackers).

entries.name: Nyaa
entries.goodFor: The main public anime tracker: fansubs, batches, BD rips, seeders.

checked.note: No Torznab API; AnimeArr uses Nyaa's RSS search (?page=rss&q=…&c=1_0) with seeders, size and info-hash.

entries.name: SubsPlease
entries.goodFor: Fast simulcast releases of airing shows (480p/720p/1080p magnets).

checked.note: JSON search API (/api/?f=search) answers; magnets only, no sizes or seeder counts.

entries.name: Tokyo Toshokan
entries.goodFor: Long-running anime torrent listing; older and niche releases.

checked.note: RSS search answers.

entries.name: Bangumi Moe
entries.goodFor: Chinese fansub releases and raws; useful for donghua.

checked.note: RSS search answers.

entries.name: ACG.RIP
entries.goodFor: Chinese fansub groups; donghua raws.

checked.note: RSS search answers.

entries.name: Mikan Project
entries.goodFor: Chinese-language anime and donghua releases.

checked.note: RSS search answers.

entries.name: dmhy (动漫花园)
entries.goodFor: The biggest Chinese anime torrent site; donghua raws.

checked.note: RSS search answers (large responses; magnet links).

entries.name: AniDex
entries.goodFor: Anime torrents with many subtitle languages.

checked.note: Not answering at check time (HTTP 502 on RSS, 403 on the site, likely a bot wall). Add it only if it works for you.

entries.name: AniRena
entries.goodFor: Older anime torrent listing.

checked.note: RSS endpoint returns HTTP 404 at check time.

entries.name: Shana Project
entries.goodFor: Follow lists: an RSS feed of the shows you follow on Shana Project (no search).

checked.note: Site up; feeds are per user (your follow list), so it isn't a search indexer. Use it in your torrent client's RSS instead.

entries.name: NZBgeek
entries.goodFor: A popular general Usenet indexer with solid anime coverage.

checked.note: Newznab caps answers. VIP (paid) account and API key required to search.

entries.name: NZBPlanet
entries.goodFor: General Usenet indexer with a long anime history.

checked.note: Newznab caps answers. Paid account and API key required.

entries.name: DrunkenSlug
entries.goodFor: Invite-only general indexer, good retention and completion.

checked.note: Newznab caps answers. Invite-only; API key required.

entries.name: NinjaCentral
entries.goodFor: General Usenet indexer (registrations open only at times).

checked.note: Newznab caps answers. Account and API key required.

entries.name: nzb.su
entries.goodFor: Long-running general Usenet indexer.

checked.note: Refuses requests without a key (HTTP 403 on caps), so only reachability was checked. Paid account and API key required.

entries.name: NZBFinder
entries.goodFor: General indexer with a small free tier and paid VIP.

checked.note: Newznab caps answers. Account and API key required.

entries.name: AnimeBytes
entries.goodFor: The best private anime tracker: complete BD/DVD collections, strict quality.

checked.note: Site up. It has its own API (passkey), not Newznab/Torznab: add it in Prowlarr (AnimeArr then sees it), or point a Torznab proxy at it.

entries.name: AnimeTorrents
entries.goodFor: Private anime tracker with long seeding.

checked.note: Site up. No Torznab of its own: add it in Prowlarr (username/password or cookie) and AnimeArr sees it through Prowlarr.
